method: Compile the production helper once with an experimental renderer that factors repeated source-author and publication-information strings into TeX macros. Compare the timing and semantic hashes with the three-run N=100 hyperref-draft-first-pass candidate series in validation-latex-hyperref-draft-first-pass-n100-20261005.json.
decision: Rejected: the single timing is 0.044 seconds below the fastest baseline run and 0.067 seconds below its median, but that median delta is smaller than the baseline range width of 0.132 seconds and does not establish a speedup; the PDF structure hash also differs from the reference. No production code was retained.
limitations: One candidate compile on one machine. No N=1,000 compile or full visual review was performed.
